name: Free Sample Agent v1.0
tagline: A free, minimal but real agent: inspect pack structure and quality before you buy. Tiny task queue + deterministic text transforms, BYO-LLM.
license: Free sample. Provided as-is for evaluation.
sync_rule: Whenever a file in this pack changes, update this JSON accordingly.

spec_sheet.what_it_does: A free, minimal but real agent: a tiny file-backed task queue feeds a deterministic text-transform pipeline (upper / lower / reverse / wordcount). Exists so a buyer can inspect pack quality and structure before paying. Runs offline; smarter with a BYO-LLM CLI.
does_not: is NOT a production business product (structural sample only)
does NOT connect to any ERP/CRM or external network
does NOT generate documents (devis, factures, reports)
spec_sheet.requirements: Python >= 3.10, stdlib only, BYO-LLM CLI optional (Claude Code / Kimi Code / Codex), systemd optional
spec_sheet.deploy: one-shot Debian : sudo bash install.sh (venv + optional systemd unit)
